title: The Flakers — Sc117: the couch pile-on — phone, pile-on, face-off, laugh (312f, KeyAnim)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: The longest scene in the archive is a single locked couch shot holding a full three-act mini-play for 312 frames: Anais alone, swooning and laughing over her phone (f1-40); Gumball and Darwin pile in on top of her in a three-head couch stack while she stays delighted underneath (f79-157); a standing confrontation (f195-234); then a shared laugh that settles into deadpan (f273-312). The stack is built for it: clean puppet layers (gb / dwn / anais) run parallel to DOMShape layers (GB / DRW / ANAIS / BRIEF) carrying the rough work, with a ROUGH layer, TEMP_PILLOWS and sofa-pillow props (GB218Flakers_Props_SophaPillows_v001.fxg) as separate items. In this KeyAnim export the heads are finished colour comps while every body is red rough lines.
notes: Longest scene in the archive: 312 frames at 25fps (about 12.5 seconds) in one shot with one background (GB218_Flakers_Sc117_LO_BG.jpg, held frames 0-312).
Two rough passes are visible in the export: red rough bodies throughout, and a second BLUE rough pass on Darwin's arms from about f234 — a later correction drawn over the red.
The couch plate renders washed-out and pale, and the right-hand cushions begin as plain beige TEMP shapes (TEMP_PILLOWS layer) — layout-stage furniture inside the KeyAnim file.
A PHONE layer sits near the top of the stack: the phone is the scene's MacGuffin — Anais holds it through the pile-on and it ends up dropped on the floor at f312.
Puppet depth is the real size of the file: Gumball 1,024 kf, Anais 911 kf, Darwin 752 kf, with Anais's head comp at 787 kf.
